data.explanation: This is a confirmation that your interest in the B1 evening course was noted, not yet an enrolment. Before you can start the course, you must book a placement test slot using the link in the separate e-mail from the course office. Do this by the deadline shown, since only sixteen people can join the course and places may fill up. If you miss the deadline, contact the course office to check whether a slot is still available.
